note: One keymap for both surfaces. Help, the shortcut sheet, menus, tooltips and aria-keyshortcuts all read this file. Per-viewer overrides are stored as a diff against it. Keys only navigate or arm; no key posts or admits work.

scopes.global: Always active; always uses a modifier (WCAG 2.1.4).
scopes.region: Active while focus is anywhere in one region (navigator, center, evidence, work view, dock).
scopes.composite: Active while focus is inside a list, grid, tree or listbox.
scopes.code: Active while focus is inside a code well (Listing, Decompile, Hex, diffs).
scopes.edit: Active in edit mode inside an editable well or inline editor; other single keys are off.

precedence: edit > code > composite > region > global. A key bound in an inner active scope shadows the outer binding and is not a conflict. Inside a code well x focuses References; in a grid x checks the row. Code wells have no checked set.
typeahead: In composites that bind single-letter commands (the Functions grid, ProblemsList, the MarksList grids, OutputsCatalog, TypeManager, TypeEditor, StackFrameEditor, SymbolTree, ProgramTreeView, MemoryMapTable and ResultsTable), typeahead starts with / into a visible filter field and plain letters are commands. Elsewhere typeahead needs no prefix.
punctuationKeys: ], [, {, } and ' match the typed character (the key value), not the physical key, and accept AltGr and dead-key input. KeymapSettings shows the layout hint.
boundOnPurpose: Ctrl/Cmd+P (browser print) and Ctrl/Cmd+F inside a code well are bound on purpose. Browser print stays in the browser menu, and a second Ctrl/Cmd+F while the well's find field is focused passes to browser find.
escapeOrder: Esc acts on the innermost layer that holds focus; an open modal is always that layer, because everything under it is inert.
1. the topmost modal (palette, go-to list, ConfirmDialog, a full-height sheet): close it and return focus to its invoker
2. the which-key hint, open Peek, sheet or menu
4. the armed ActionStrip, only when focus is inside it: disarm it and keep its fields as a draft
5. a transient extent such as a byte range: collapse it to the cursor
6. a transient filter typed in this view: clear it
7. in a secondary or held pane: return focus to the primary pane
never: Esc never clears the checked set, releases held panes, removes kept cards, discards drafts or goes Back

profiles.default: Modifier globals plus focus-scoped single keys below.
profiles.ida: Adds focus-scoped n (rename), y (set type), ; (opens the comment editor) and d (disassemble; arms only) in code wells. Go to address is g then g from the leader, as in every profile.
profiles.off: Turns every single-character key off; modifier globals and menus remain.

profilesNote: Ghidra-style and VS Code-style profiles are deferred until each is specified against this file. F12 stays browser-reserved, and Esc never goes Back in any profile.

commands.label: Go
commands.note: Moves the primary location and pushes one history stop.

commands.label: Open beside
commands.where: any typed link; Shift+click only outside checkable grids
commands.note: Creates a Held pane. The primary selection does not change and no stop is pushed. In checkable grids Shift+click extends the checked set (list.range), so Open beside there is Shift+Enter or the link menu. On 8080 without split panes it opens a new window.

commands.label: Peek
commands.note: Also after a 400ms pointer rest (peek-pointer-rest) or an 800ms focus rest (peek-focus-rest); focus-rest opening is off by default at 400% zoom and below 700px. Alt+Enter and Ctrl/Cmd+I are rejected. aria-keyshortcuts is set once on the well or grid, not on every token.

commands.label: Keep
commands.where: inside a Peek or evidence card
commands.note: The Keep button (aria-pressed) is the primary control. The letter works only while focus is inside a Peek or on a kept card, never on list rows (where k moves); from a trigger, Tab then K, or the link menu. Carried as keep=…

commands.label: Link menu
commands.note: One flat APG Menu: Open · Open beside · Peek · Keep; Edit (editable tokens only, items from GET /api/v1/actions, inapplicable items aria-disabled with the reason); Reveal in; Copy. With a coarse pointer the 44px row-menu button opens the same menu. Shift+right-click passes through to the browser menu.

commands.label: Open in new browser tab
commands.where: any typed link; Ctrl/Cmd+click only outside checkable grids
commands.note: Native browser behavior. In checkable grids Ctrl/Cmd+click toggles the row (list.toggle); a new tab there is Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, middle-click or the link menu.

commands.label: Command palette
commands.note: Opens the modal CommandPalette with > typed; it shares the go-to engine.

commands.label: Go to anything
commands.note: Focuses the NavigationBar go-to combobox. Below 1100px, where the field is collapsed, it opens the same engine in the palette dialog. A prefix counts only as the first character: @ or :: symbol, : address, # logical id, ! job, % receipt or basis digest, ~ node, > command, $ string, ' marks and program bookmarks. ? is not a prefix, because decorated names start with it; help is Ctrl/Cmd+/ and the Help menu. The empty query lists Recent locations, Marks, Recent actions and Recent jobs.

commands.label: Go to address
commands.note: Focuses the go-to field with : typed. Its first, highlighted row is the last address jump ('Last: build-b:0041b2c0'), so Enter repeats it visibly. Also g then g inside a list, grid, tree or code well.

commands.label: Back
commands.note: Always acts on the primary history. Not intercepted in text fields or edit mode. Mouse buttons 4/5 and the browser buttons work natively through popstate. Held panes' own Back/Forward buttons never touch browser history.

commands.label: Forward
commands.note: Always acts on the primary history. Not intercepted in text fields or edit mode. Mouse buttons 4/5 and the browser buttons work natively through popstate. Held panes' own Back/Forward buttons never touch browser history.

commands.label: Recent locations
keys: Enter on the Recent menu button
commands.note: APG Menu Button beside Back: up to 20 of this tab's stops with label, time and ✎ edited. Back itself has no history menu, no Alt+↓ and no long-press.

commands.label: Next region
commands.note: Cycles header, navigator, center, evidence, work view and dock in visual order and restores each region's last focus. Where the browser or a screen reader takes F6, use g then the region letter (platformCautions).

commands.label: Previous region
commands.note: The reverse of F6, with the same focus memory.

commands.label: Show or hide evidence rail
commands.note: Ctrl+Alt+B types a character on some AltGr layouts; there the editor shows the altGrCaution warning and the command stays reachable through the palette, the View menu and g then e (focus the rail, which opens it).

commands.label: Show or hide dock
commands.note: Only shows or hides the dock. Hiding the region that holds focus moves focus to its collapse strip. F6 and Shift+F6 return with focus memory.

commands.label: Go to last announcement
commands.note: Opens the dock if it is collapsed and focuses the row of the last announced transition. Also the palette.

commands.label: Next build with a counterpart
commands.note: Steps to the next build with a single-address counterpart (resolved, pinned or degraded) and an accepted or candidate identity edge. It skips absent, unresolved, ambiguous and contested builds and announces them by state. In a derived pane it moves that pane's build.

commands.label: Previous build with a counterpart
commands.note: The reverse of build.next, with the same skipping and announcement.

commands.label: Next worklist item
commands.note: Moves the primary selection and focus to the next item, like Go; from the stepper toolbar focus stays on the stepper. With no active worklist it says 'No active worklist' and names the collect paths (Collect into worklist, w; Step problems on the Problems tab); there is no implicit default. It does nothing while an inline editor is open or the ActionStrip holds unsent edited fields ('Finish or cancel the edit first (Esc)'). At a program boundary it stops once ('Next: build-c · clears 4 checked rows on build-b'); a second press continues. Also the stepper buttons and the palette (platformCautions: Fn on macOS).

commands.label: Previous worklist item
commands.note: The reverse of worklist.next, with the same edit guard and boundary stop.

commands.label: Mark item handled
commands.note: No default key. A per-viewer checklist toggle described 'your checklist · not a review decision · starts no work'. The item grid is not checkable, so Space and x do not toggle it.

commands.label: Next difference
commands.where: diffs, SplitCompare, CandidateAlignment, ReviewDetail, ObjectDiff and SourceRepairDiff
commands.note: Steps hunks or alignment anchors and says 'Difference 2 of 9: 0041b240 differs'. Also the toolbar's difference buttons and the palette (platformCautions: caret browsing).

commands.label: Previous difference
commands.where: diffs, SplitCompare, CandidateAlignment, ReviewDetail, ObjectDiff and SourceRepairDiff

commands.label: Layout preset 1–5
commands.note: Read, Compare, Review, Triage, Verify rebuild; also in the View menu, the palette and the NavigationBar layout menu. Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+digit was rejected because it types characters on AltGr keyboards. A switch pushes history only when it changes the workspace.

commands.label: Keyboard shortcuts
commands.note: Also the Help menu and the palette ('keys', 'shortcuts'). ? is not bound.

commands.label: Accessibility help for this view
commands.note: GNOME and KDE take Alt+F1 (platformCautions). Remappable; also the palette, the Help menu and the pane-header button.

commands.label: Accessible View
commands.note: GNOME and KDE take Alt+F2 (platformCautions). Remappable; also the palette, the Help menu and the pane-header button.

commands.label: Tab moves focus (in editable wells)
commands.note: On macOS Cmd+M minimizes the window, so the toggle uses Ctrl+Shift+M there. The status line shows the state.

commands.label: Move selection
commands.note: Following panes update after the settle delay.

commands.label: Check row
commands.where: checkable lists and grids; never in code wells, which have no checked set

commands.label: Extend checked range
commands.note: Shift-click anywhere on a row, including its name link, extends the checked set (Grid modifier precedence). Outside checkable grids Shift+click is Open beside.

commands.label: Toggle row in checked set
commands.note: Toggles one row, including a click on its name link (Grid modifier precedence). Outside checkable grids Ctrl/Cmd+click opens a browser tab.

commands.label: Repeat armed action on focused row
commands.note: Rebinds the armed ActionStrip action to the focused row and focuses Run; never posts.

commands.label: Set mark
commands.note: Per viewer, lowercase a–z; named marks through the palette ('Set mark…'). A mark is scoped to the concrete build and address where it was set; 'Set logical mark…' (palette, row menu) makes one that resolves on other builds through the locator. Marks and notes are per-viewer annotations: never input to context fusion, propagation or agent bundles, and never a claim tier.

commands.label: Jump to mark
commands.note: Matches the typed ' character and accepts a dead-key composition; the go-to ' chip and g then ' are fallbacks.

commands.label: Collect into worklist
commands.note: Collects the current result set as a snapshot worklist through the MarksList dialog. The active worklist is never replaced silently.

commands.label: Type to filter
commands.note: Starts typeahead in a visible filter field; plain letters stay commands there.

commands.label: Move by cell
commands.where: cell-focus matrices (ReadinessMatrix and its slots mode)
commands.note: Arrows move focus only; Enter commits.

commands.label: Open both endpoints beside
commands.note: Re-points the Review held-pair slot to the focused match; it never adds holds.

commands.label: Arm Decide for the checked set
Zoom in
commands.note: Also the toolbar's Zoom in button. Remappable; off under the off profile.

commands.label: Zoom out
commands.note: Also the toolbar's Zoom out button.

commands.label: Fit graph
commands.note: Also the toolbar's Fit button.

commands.label: Incoming
commands.where: XrefPanel and CallHierarchy grids, and the GraphPane Calls graph, only
commands.note: Switches the direction to incoming.

commands.label: Outgoing
commands.where: XrefPanel and CallHierarchy grids, and the GraphPane Calls graph, only
commands.note: Switches the direction to outgoing. g then o stays the outline chord: after g, the next key belongs to the leader.

commands.label: Token or line
commands.note: Toggles token and line scope.

commands.label: Expand siblings
commands.where: GraphPane list form, CallHierarchy, TypeManager, SymbolTree and ProgramTreeView only
commands.note: Opens every sibling of the focused row within the depth limit (APG tree).

commands.label: Rename
commands.where: session tabs, function rows, label rows, SymbolTree and ProgramTreeView nodes, and the MemoryMapTable block name
commands.note: Opens the inline editor in place. Locals, parameters and labels in code wells use code.rename.

commands.label: Rename in place
commands.where: locals, parameters and labels in code wells
commands.note: Opens InlineRename under the line, never over it; it confirms in place.

commands.label: Move tab
commands.note: Menu-only: the tab's context menu and the palette ('Move tab left', 'Move tab right'). Ctrl+Shift+PageUp/PageDown are browser-taken.

commands.label: Focus reflected row in the other view
commands.note: Targets: Listing → Decompile, Decompile → Listing, Hex → Listing, Graph → Listing at the block's first instruction. A hidden target view is shown in the same slot and the switch is announced once. With no mapping focus stays ('No mapping; focus stays'). Also 'Show reflected row' in the link menu, the row menu and the palette.

commands.label: Highlight all occurrences
commands.note: Up to four highlights, lettered A–D, in each visible view of the same build; a fifth says 'Four highlights in use; remove one'. Per-viewer view state, never in the URL. Also 'Highlight all' in the link menu, the row menu and the palette.

commands.label: Focus references panel
commands.note: Code scope wins over composite, so inside a code well x focuses References and never checks a row.

commands.label: Next reference in the panel
commands.note: The first press snapshots the References list and keeps the section ('Kept · stepping references to ‹token› · 3 of 12 · as listed 14:02', keep=); it stops following until Follow selection or Esc inside the section. The first step pushes one history stop from the origin; later steps replace it, so one Alt+← returns. Steps stop at either end and say so, never wrap, never change build and never touch the active worklist.

commands.label: Previous reference in the panel
commands.note: The reverse of code.xrefNext, with the same snapshot and history rules.

commands.label: Find in this well
commands.note: Announces '3 of 12 matches'; HexStrip matches byte patterns. A second Ctrl/Cmd+F while the well's find field is focused passes to browser find; outside a well it is browser find.

commands.label: Rename (IDA profile)
commands.note: profile ida; opens InlineRename under the line

commands.label: Set type (IDA profile)
commands.note: profile ida; opens the type editor under the line

commands.label: Comment (IDA profile)
commands.note: profile ida; opens the comment editor (InlineRename Comment mode) under the line

commands.label: Leader for region and view jumps
commands.note: Shows which-key hints, only in the composite and code scopes. Regions: g n navigator, g m main, g e evidence, g w work view, g j dock at the row of the last announced transition (dock.lastAnnouncement). Views: g l listing, g d decompile, g h hex, g r graph. Panels: g o outline, g x references, g c counterparts, g ' marks. Compiler-aware panes: g t transformation timeline, g i match explanation, g f stack frame, g v vtable slots. Dock: g p Problems tab. g b build menu. g g go to address. Layouts: g 1…5. Sequences go in aria-describedby text, not aria-keyshortcuts. Analysis: g a the AnalyzerPanel.

commands.label: Function outline
commands.note: Blocks, locals, calls and strings of the current function; the same projection as the rail's Outline section. Also the Views toolbar's Outline button and the palette ('Outline of this function'). Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+O is not bound.

commands.label: Walk pointer at cursor
commands.where: Listing, DecompileView and SplitCompare wells, on an operand or expression
commands.note: Opens PointerWalk for the cursor's expression and focuses the current step; only view state (walk=), nothing posts. Checked against precedence and profiles: no other code or composite binding uses p in code wells (g then p is a leader chord, not a conflict), and the ida profile adds only n, y and ;. IDA users know p as a mutating command; here it only reads. Also the link menu (Reveal in: PointerWalk) and the palette ('Walk pointer at cursor').

commands.label: Compiler layer on or off
commands.note: Toggles CompilerLayer (layers=compiler) over every visible code well of the Code Browser and SplitCompare; only view state, nothing posts. Checked against precedence and profiles: no other code-scope binding uses c; c in the OutputsCatalog, TypeEditor and StackFrameEditor grids is composite scope inside those grids, never in a code well; g then c (counterparts) is a leader chord; m then c and ' then c are mark letters. IDA users know c as a mutating command; here it only changes the view. Also the Views toolbar's Compiler layer toggle (aria-pressed) and the palette ('Compiler layer').

commands.label: Next compiler annotation
commands.where: code wells while the compiler layer is on
commands.note: Moves the cursor to the next annotation of the visible kinds and announces it ('Annotation 3 of 9: inlined ResourceRef::Resolve, hypothesis'). Stops at the end and says so; never wraps. Proposed as } in the CompilerLayer README; } and { are code.arrowTarget and code.arrowSource (ListingFieldLayout), so annotation stepping uses a and Shift+A to keep one binding per key per scope. a is otherwise unbound in code wells (a in the TypeManager grid is composite scope inside that grid; g then a is a leader chord); the ida profile does not bind it. With the layer off it says 'Compiler layer is off'. Also the layer bar's next button and the palette ('Next compiler annotation').

commands.label: Previous compiler annotation
commands.where: code wells while the compiler layer is on
commands.note: The reverse of code.annotationNext, with the same stops and announcement. Also the layer bar's previous button and the palette ('Previous compiler annotation').

commands.label: Transformation timeline
commands.note: Moves focus to TransformTimeline for the entity and cmp pair (secondary pane or rail section), showing it if hidden. Also the palette ('Transformation timeline') and Reveal in from CompilerLayer.

commands.label: Explain match
commands.note: Moves focus to MatchExplain for the entity's stored comparison receipt. Nothing is compiled or compared. Also the palette ('Explain match') and Reveal in from ObjectDiff.

commands.label: Stack frame
commands.note: Moves focus to FrameLayout for the selected function. g then f was also proposed as a SearchWorkbench leader chord; search has no leader chord (search.open is Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F). Also the palette ('Stack frame') and Reveal in from MatchExplain and PointerWalk.

commands.label: Virtual table slots
commands.note: Moves focus to VTableBrowser for the class of the selected method or type. g then v was also proposed for version control (vcs.open, palette and menu only) and for OverviewBar (overview.focus, which has no default key and uses its Show key button and the palette). Also the palette ('Virtual table slots') and Reveal in from PointerWalk.

commands.label: Collapse or expand function
commands.where: the Listing, on a function header or body row
commands.note: Collapses or expands the function at the cursor when the Function row kind's Collapsible body option is on (ListingFieldLayout, row L31); view state only, nothing posts. Checked: z is unbound in code wells and in every composite, the ida profile adds only n, y, ; and d, and Ctrl/Cmd+Z (edit.undo) is a modifier global, not the same key. Find, Highlight all and F8 still reach collapsed rows and expand them on arrival. Also the header row's Collapse button and the palette ('Collapse function').

commands.label: Go to flow-arrow source
commands.where: the Listing, on a row with a flow arrow in the flow-arrow margin
commands.note: Moves the cursor to the source of the arrow at the cursor and pushes one history stop (ListingFieldLayout, row L15). { and } match the typed character (punctuationKeys), so they are distinct from [ and ] (code.xrefPrev, code.xrefNext) on every layout. They were also proposed for compiler-annotation stepping, which uses a and Shift+A instead. Unbound in the ida profile. Also the margin cell's link menu ('Go to source') and the palette.

commands.label: Go to flow-arrow target
commands.where: the Listing, on a row with a flow arrow in the flow-arrow margin
commands.note: Moves the cursor to the target of the arrow at the cursor and pushes one history stop. A computed target inferred by analysis is announced as 'hypothesis · basis: jump-table inference'. See code.arrowSource for the conflict check. Also the margin cell's link menu ('Go to target') and the palette.

commands.label: Listing fields
commands.note: No default key. The pane header's Fields toggle (aria-pressed) and the palette ('Listing fields…') open ListingFieldLayout; per-viewer view state only.

commands.label: Move field
commands.note: ←/→ move the focused field within its format row; ↑/↓ move it to the previous or next format row. Never Alt+←/→, which stay history.back and history.forward. Composite scope, never in text fields, so the platform's Shift+Ctrl/Cmd+arrow text selection is untouched; not browser-reserved. Also each field control's menu (Move left, Move right, Move to row…); dragging is optional (WCAG 2.5.7).

commands.label: Field on or off
commands.note: Switches the focused field between on and off (off keeps its space). The format rows are toolbars, not checkable grids, so this does not collide with list.check. Per-viewer view state.

commands.label: Remove field
commands.note: Moves the focused field to Available fields and says 'Removed Stack depth · Add to restore'. View state only; it never touches program data. Delete in the Sessions tablist (tabs.close) and other grids is a different composite.

commands.label: Field settings
commands.note: Opens the focused field's settings group. Field controls are not typed links, so the link meaning of Enter (link.go) does not apply there.

commands.label: Overview ranges
commands.where: Listing well with the OverviewBar shown, palette
commands.note: No default key. g then v was proposed and belongs to VTableBrowser (code.vtables). The OverviewBar's Show key button and the palette ('Overview ranges') move focus to the ranges list.

commands.label: Next region in lane
commands.note: Moves to the next region of the lane in focus; stops at the end and says so, never wraps. Composite scope inside the ranges list; ] in code wells (code.xrefNext) is code scope and [ in the TypeEditor and StackFrameEditor grids is composite inside those grids. Matches the typed character.

commands.label: Previous region in lane
commands.note: Moves to the previous region of the lane in focus. See overview.nextMarker.

commands.label: Filter to one lane
commands.note: No default key: m is list.mark in lists. The lane menu and the key's lane rows filter the list to one lane; Esc clears the filter (escapeOrder 6).

commands.label: Cut symbols
commands.note: Marks the focused or checked nodes as cut ('cut · paste to move'). Client state only; it never posts. Composite scope, never in text fields, where the browser's cut applies; not browser-reserved. Esc clears the cut as a transient extent (escapeOrder 5); Esc never clears the checked set.

commands.label: Paste symbols here
commands.where: the SymbolTree treegrid only, on a destination namespace or class
commands.note: Arms the Move action in the ActionStrip bound to that build and names it; it never posts. Run posts, with ConfirmDialog for a batch. Composite scope, never in text fields.

commands.label: Delete symbol
commands.note: Arms Delete in the ActionStrip; ConfirmDialog names the build, the count and the references that become unnamed. A single key never destroys.

commands.label: Create namespace
commands.note: No default key; the row menu and the palette ('Create namespace…'). Confirms in its inline editor.

commands.label: Logical or one build
commands.note: Switches between Logical · all builds and one-build scope and announces it. s is composite inside this treegrid; s in the ProgramTreeView (ptree.select) and ResultsTable (results.makeSelection) grids is a different composite. Typeahead starts with /.

commands.label: Restrict Listing view
commands.note: Restricts the Listing view to the focused folder or fragment (f=ptree.view, replaceState; not a history stop). View state only. g then v is a leader chord, not this key. Typeahead starts with /.

commands.label: Add to Listing view
commands.note: Adds the focused node to the current view restriction. View state only.

commands.label: Clear Listing view
commands.note: No default key; the view band's Clear view button and the palette ('Clear Listing view'). Esc does not clear it: the restriction is view state, not a transient filter.

commands.label: Select in Listing
commands.note: Makes the Listing's address-set selection on this build from the node's addresses; client state, never in the URL, and read-only.

commands.label: Edit block
commands.note: Opens the inline editor for the focused block (name, R/W/X, volatile, artificial, comment). It only opens; Save posts once. Ctrl/Cmd+E stays browser-reserved; e is a plain letter inside this grid. F2 opens the same editor on the name.

commands.label: This build or Align builds
commands.note: Switches between This build and Align builds. a is composite inside this grid; a in the TypeManager grid (types.scope) is another composite and code-scope a (code.annotationNext) applies only in code wells.

commands.label: Add sort key
commands.note: Adds the column as the next sort key (order numbers ▲1, ▼2). Header cells are sort buttons, not typed links, so link.openBeside does not apply there.

commands.label: Make selection
commands.note: Sets the Listing's address-set selection on one build from the checked rows, or all rows; with all builds in scope it asks which build. Client state, never in the URL.

commands.label: Copy
commands.note: Copies the focused cell or the checked rows, in the chosen columns. Composite scope, never in text fields, where the browser's copy applies; not browser-reserved.

commands.label: Columns
commands.note: No default key; the toolbar's Columns… button and the palette.

commands.label: Export CSV
commands.note: No default key; the toolbar's Export CSV… button and the palette. Ctrl/Cmd+E is browser-reserved.

commands.label: Remove from table
commands.note: Removes the focused or checked rows from this view only ('Removed 3 rows from this table; nothing in the program changed'); never from the program. The rows return on Refresh.

commands.label: Search
commands.note: Opens SearchWorkbench (panel=search, Code Browser workspace) in the last mode and focuses the query; it never runs a search. No leader chord: g then f belongs to FrameLayout (code.frame). Not browser-reserved; it has a platform caution (see platformCautions). Also the palette ('Search…') and the Code Browser's Search menu.

commands.label: Search next
commands.where: SearchWorkbench, memory, text and instruction modes
commands.note: Incremental search forward from the Listing cursor on this build only; moves the cursor with replaceState, like Find. In the one-line query field the platform's Cmd+↓ caret move is shadowed on purpose. Also the Next button.

commands.label: Search previous
commands.where: SearchWorkbench, memory, text and instruction modes
commands.note: Incremental search backward from the Listing cursor on this build only. See search.next. Also the Previous button.

commands.label: Load selection into pattern
commands.note: No default key; the pattern builder's Load selection button and the palette.

commands.label: Analysis
commands.where: lists, grids, trees and code wells (leader)
commands.note: Opens AnalyzerPanel (panel=analysis with build) and focuses it. It reads each build's analyzer configuration; no key runs analysis. Run in the ActionStrip posts, with ConfirmDialog for cross-build and forced runs. Also the Analysis menu, a build's row menu and the palette ('Analysis', 'Analyzers', 'One-shot').

commands.label: Version control
commands.where: Project menu, a build's row menu, palette
commands.note: Menu and palette only ('Version control', 'Check in…', 'Update…'); opens VersionControlPanel (panel=versions with build). Its proposed g then v went to the vtable browser (code.vtables), which had the stronger code-well use; version control is a project-level action reached from menus. No key checks in, updates or checks out.

commands.label: Undo
commands.note: Undo of the build's top program transaction through the catalog (EditHistory, panel=history). Never active in text fields or edit mode, where the browser's own undo applies, and shadowed by inner-scope draft undo (typeEditor.draftUndo). A single top undo of a single-target edit confirms in place, naming the transaction and build; a batch, cross-build or multi-step undo (Undo to here…) arms ConfirmDialog. Never posts silently. Also the Edit menu and the palette ('Undo').

commands.label: Redo
commands.note: Redo of the build's next undone transaction through the catalog. Same rules as edit.undo: never in text fields or edit mode; a single-target redo confirms in place, anything wider arms ConfirmDialog; never posts silently. Also the Edit menu and the palette ('Redo').

commands.label: Scripts
commands.note: Menu and palette only ('Scripts', 'Run script…', 'Interpreter'); opens ScriptConsole (panel=scripts), shown only when Advanced is on in View settings. No key runs a script.

commands.label: Run last script
commands.note: Menu and palette only. Arms the last script's run for its named build; the ConfirmDialog still opens and nothing posts from a key.

commands.label: Export
commands.where: File menu, link menu, Build menu, palette
commands.note: Menu and palette only; opens ExportDialog. Ctrl/Cmd+E is browser-reserved. Exports land as artifacts in OutputsCatalog.

commands.label: Tool options
commands.note: Menu and palette only ('Options', 'Tool options'); opens OptionsPanel. Cmd+, is taken by the browser on macOS.

commands.label: Select bytes by count
commands.note: Menu and palette only. Sets a transient byte range from the cursor; view state only.

commands.label: Checksums of selection
commands.note: Menu and palette only. Reads checksums of the selected bytes; nothing is written.

commands.label: Next instruction
commands.note: No default key; remappable in KeymapSettings. Moves the cursor to the next instruction in the inspected build, stops at the end and says so, never wraps. Palette ('Next instruction') and the Listing's navigation menu.

commands.label: Copy artifact path
commands.note: Copies the focused row's stored path and announces it ('Copied path out/hookpack-v1.json'). With no stored file it does nothing and says why ('No stored path: ‹reason›'). Read-only. Composite scope inside the grid; code-scope c (code.compilerLayer) applies only in code wells. Also the row's Copy path button, the link menu and the palette.

commands.label: Toggle favourite type
commands.where: the TypeManager tree and grid only
commands.note: Per-viewer state, not a mutation. Also the row menu and the palette.

commands.label: This build or all builds
commands.where: the TypeManager tree and grid only
commands.note: Switches the Types scope between This build and All builds (f=type.scope). Composite scope inside TypeManager; code-scope a (code.annotationNext) applies only in code wells.

commands.label: Reveal uses of type
commands.where: the TypeManager tree and grid only
commands.note: Reveals uses on the inspected build (f=type.use). Read-only.

commands.label: Find type
commands.where: the TypeManager tree and grid only
commands.note: Focuses the Types Find field (f=type.find); the same key and behavior as list.typeahead there, so it is an alias, not a conflict.

commands.label: Move component up
commands.note: Moves the component in the draft; plain Alt+↓ stays Peek. No single key ever writes: keys only open, arm or move within a draft, and Save or the confirm posts.

commands.label: Move component down
commands.note: Moves the component in the draft. No single key ever writes: keys only open, arm or move within a draft, and Save or the confirm posts.

commands.label: Insert undefined
commands.note: Inserts an undefined byte in the draft. No single key ever writes: keys only open, arm or move within a draft, and Save or the confirm posts.

commands.label: Duplicate component
commands.note: Duplicates the component in the draft. No single key ever writes: keys only open, arm or move within a draft, and Save or the confirm posts.

commands.label: Make array
commands.note: Opens the array count field for the component in the draft. Matches the typed character. No single key ever writes: keys only open, arm or move within a draft, and Save or the confirm posts.

commands.label: Clear component
commands.note: Clears the component in the draft; the layout change confirms through ConfirmDialog on Save. Composite scope inside the grid; code-scope c (code.compilerLayer) applies only in code wells. No single key ever writes: keys only open, arm or move within a draft, and Save or the confirm posts.

commands.label: Delete component
commands.note: Deletes the component in the draft. No single key ever writes: keys only open, arm or move within a draft, and Save or the confirm posts.

commands.label: Go to offset
commands.note: Moves focus to the component at an offset; navigation only.

commands.label: Hex offsets
commands.note: Toggles hex or decimal offsets; view state only. Shared with frame.hex in its own grid.

commands.label: Undo draft change
commands.where: the TypeEditor grid and its edit mode
commands.note: Undoes a change in the unsaved draft; never undoes a program transaction. Shadows edit.undo inside the editor by scope precedence.

commands.label: Redo draft change
commands.where: the TypeEditor grid and its edit mode
commands.note: Redoes a draft change; never a program transaction. Shadows edit.redo inside the editor.

commands.label: Move parameter up
commands.note: Moves the parameter in the draft; the callee-signature edit confirms through ConfirmDialog on Save. No single key ever writes: keys only open, arm or move within a draft, and Save or the confirm posts.

commands.label: Move parameter down
commands.note: Moves the parameter in the draft. No single key ever writes: keys only open, arm or move within a draft, and Save or the confirm posts.

commands.label: Edit storage
commands.note: No default key (Alt+S, proposed in the SignatureEditor README, opens a browser menu on some platforms). Opens StorageEditor for the focused parameter. Palette and the parameter's row menu.

commands.label: Edit signature
commands.where: a function name or call site in a code well
commands.note: No default key in any profile: y on a function name is already set type in the ida profile. Opens SignatureEditor for an explicit target build; the path is Shift+F10 → Edit signature… or the palette.

commands.label: New stack variable
commands.note: Adds a variable in the draft. No single key ever writes: keys only open, arm or move within a draft, and Save or the confirm posts.

commands.label: Clear stack slot
commands.note: Clears the slot in the draft. Composite scope inside the grid; not code-scope c. No single key ever writes: keys only open, arm or move within a draft, and Save or the confirm posts.

commands.label: Make array
commands.note: Opens the array count field in the draft. No single key ever writes: keys only open, arm or move within a draft, and Save or the confirm posts.

commands.label: Delete stack variable
commands.note: Deletes the variable in the draft. No single key ever writes: keys only open, arm or move within a draft, and Save or the confirm posts.

commands.label: Hex offsets
commands.note: Toggles hex or decimal offsets; view state only. Shared with typeEditor.hex in its own grid.

commands.label: Go to offset
commands.note: Moves focus to the slot at an offset; navigation only.

commands.label: Edit references
commands.where: an operand or instruction in a code well
commands.note: No default key: Ctrl+R reloads the page. Opens ReferenceEditor for the inspected build. Link menu and the palette ('Edit references').

commands.label: Flow override
commands.note: Palette and menu only. Arms the flow override in the editor; Save posts.

commands.label: Set fallthrough
commands.note: Palette and menu only. Arms the fallthrough change in the editor; Save posts.

commands.label: Register values
commands.note: No default key; palette ('Register values') and menu. Opens RegisterValuesEditor for the inspected build.

commands.label: Set register value over selection
commands.where: RegisterValuesEditor and code wells with a selection
commands.note: Link menu and palette only; arms, never posts.

commands.label: Clear register value in selection
commands.where: RegisterValuesEditor and code wells with a selection
commands.note: Link menu and palette only; arms, never posts.

commands.label: Patch instruction
commands.where: an instruction in a code well
commands.note: No default key. Opens PatchEditor for the inspected build; link menu and palette ('Patch instruction'). Patched bytes are not recovery evidence.

commands.label: Patch bytes
commands.note: No default key. Opens PatchEditor in byte mode; link menu and palette.

commands.label: Clear code
commands.note: No default key; Delete is not bound because a single key never destroys. Arms the clear in PatchEditor's confirm path; link menu and palette.

commands.label: Create data
commands.note: No default key. Arms the data type choice for the inspected build; link menu and palette.

commands.label: Disassemble
commands.where: undefined bytes in a code well
commands.note: The ida profile binds d, matching its habit; the default profile has no key. Arms disassembly for the inspected build; nothing posts from the key. Also the link menu and the palette.

commands.label: Hold this pane
commands.note: aria-pressed toggle with a stable name in the pane header; also the pane menu and the palette. Carried in hold= (two at most); a further hold becomes a Kept card with a notice.

commands.label: Make primary
commands.note: Moves the one selection to the held location, pushes a stop and releases the hold; the pane stays open and follows. Also the pane menu and the palette.

commands.label: Follow again
commands.note: Turns the pane back into a following pane. Pane menu and palette.

commands.label: Release
commands.note: Releases the hold or the kept card. Pane or card menu, and the palette.

commands.label: Update panes
commands.note: Radio group 'As I move' / 'On Enter'; also the View menu and the palette. Below 700px it is forced to 'On Enter' and says so.

commands.label: Expand all sections
commands.note: Per-viewer collapsed state lives in durable workspace state. Rail header menu and palette.

commands.label: Collapse all sections
commands.note: Rail header menu and palette.

conflictPolicy: Two commands bound to the same key in the same scope do nothing until the conflict is resolved; the status line says which binding is blocked and why.
altGrCaution: Ctrl+Alt combinations type characters on AltGr keyboards. The editor warns when a binding (default or remap) uses one on the active layout, and every such command stays reachable from the palette and the View menu.

platformCautions.cause: Some browsers and screen readers take it.
platformCautions.fallback: g then the region letter; the palette.
The toolbar's difference buttons; the palette ('Next difference').

platformCautions.cause: Needs Fn on many macOS keyboards.
platformCautions.fallback: The stepper buttons; the palette ('Next worklist item', 'Previous worklist item').

platformCautions.cause: Some input methods take Ctrl+Shift+F (for example to switch simplified and traditional characters), and some macOS browsers bind Cmd+Shift+F to a full-screen or toolbar command.
platformCautions.fallback: The palette ('Search…') and the Code Browser's Search menu; the binding is remappable.
The palette, the Help menu and the pane-header button; the binding is remappable.

platformCautions.cause: They type characters on AltGr layouts (altGrCaution).
platformCautions.fallback: The palette and the View menu.
